svg.title: The guard's patrol in the example and one loop-making obstacle
svg.desc: Left: the guard walks up from the caret, turning right at every obstacle, and covers 41 cells before leaving the map. Right: placing a new obstacle at column 3, row 6 sends the guard around a closed loop; 6 cells in total have this effect.

g.text: Simulate, then brute-force the extra obstacle
the guard turns right whenever the next cell is #
Part 1 · walk until leaving the map
41 distinct cells visited = entries in the visited map
Part 2 · try an obstacle on every free cell
O at (3,6) traps the guard in a loop
dashed circles: the other 5 cells that also work
loop test · C3: count the turns made while standing on each cell, a cell reaching 4 turns means a loop
loop test · Python: count the hits on each obstacle, any obstacle hit 8 times means a loop
